rows.name:
A Defence Force Soldier set off towards the Cylinder[XENO:n ]
Hangar some time ago and hasn't been heard from[XENO:n ]
since. Head to the area and locate the soldier.

Speak to the Defence Force soldier[XENO:n ]
near the Cylinder Hangar.

The missing soldier has been accounted for,[XENO:n ]
alive and well!

Arachno Silk fetches a high price when sold.[XENO:n ]
Help enrich the lives of a Defence Force soldier's[XENO:n ]
six-child family by collecting some.

Collect 3 pieces of [System:Color name=item ]Arachno Silk[/System:Color] from Worker[XENO:n ]
Arachno in Tephra Cave.

Plenty of silk collected! This should help ease[XENO:n ]
the soldier's family's hardship.

A Defence Force Soldier wishes to reward your help[XENO:n ]
so far by giving you something he buried on his way[XENO:n ]
back from Colony 6. Head there and dig up the item.

Exit Tephra Cave and check the area[XENO:n ]
immediately on the left.
You found the item buried by the soldier.

There are reports of large numbers of monsters in the[XENO:n ]
deep recesses of Tephra Cave. Clear them out to[XENO:n ]
provide safe passage for the Defence Force Soldiers.

Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Devoted Arachno[/System:Color] near Vilia Lake[XENO:n ]
in Tephra Cave.

Defeat 4 [System:Color name=item ]Resolute Arachno[/System:Color] near Vilia Lake[XENO:n ]
in Tephra Cave.

Defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Zealous Arachno[/System:Color] near Vilia Lake[XENO:n ]
in Tephra Cave.

The area near Vilia Lake is now free of monsters[XENO:n ]
and will allow safe passage!

Shura has come to investigate Giants' ruins, but[XENO:n ]
hasn't made much progress alone. Retrieve a book[XENO:n ]
containing a hint on how to open Bafalgar Tomb.

Find the [System:Color name=item ]Starlight Book[/System:Color] near Vilia Lake in[XENO:n ]
Tephra Cave.
Return to Shura.

You found the Starlight Book! Opening the[XENO:n ]
hidden door should now be possible.

According to the Starlight Book, an offering must be[XENO:n ]
made in order to open the door. Collect the White[XENO:n ]
Spider Heart and offer it up at the altar.

Defeat Dazzling Tolosnia near the Heavenly[XENO:n ]
Window and collect the [System:Color name=item ]White Spider Heart[/System:Color].

Offer up the White Spider Heart at the Bafalgar[XENO:n ]
Tomb altar.
Return to Shura.

Offering up the White Spider Heart opened the[XENO:n ]
door. Time to head inside.

Despite the door now being open, Shura isn't keen on[XENO:n ]
going inside. Head in and take a look around the[XENO:n ]
Prayer Room in Bafalgar Tomb.

Enter and search the Prayer Room[XENO:n ]
in Bafalgar Tomb.
Return to Shura.

Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Sacrificial Tablet[/System:Color] from near the Path[XENO:n ]
of Absolution in Tephra Cave.
Return to Shura.

Nothing special was found inside but more doors[XENO:n ]
can now be opened.

The investigation of Bafalgar Tomb is almost over.[XENO:n ]
With the hidden door now open, locate a critical hint[XENO:n ]
from the Soothsayer's Crypt.

Find the hint in the Soothsayer's Crypt in Tephra[XENO:n ]
Cave.
Return to Shura.

You gave the Moonlight Book to Shura. With both[XENO:n ]
books it should be possible to investigate further.

You didn't receive your reward for assisting Shura in[XENO:n ]
her investigation of Bafalgar Tomb. Make your way to[XENO:n ]
Colony 9 to claim your prize.

Speak to Shura in the Colony 9 Commercial[XENO:n ]
District.

To thank you for your help at Bafalgar Tomb,[XENO:n ]
Shura has presented a family heirloom.

A Defence Force soldier isn't making much progress[XENO:n ]
collecting items required to help restore Colony 9.[XENO:n ]
Lend your services and help collect what's needed.
Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Kneecap Rocks[/System:Color] in Tephra Cave.

Items collected! These should enable the ruined[XENO:n ]
buildings to be restored.

A Defence Force soldier isn't making much progress[XENO:n ]
collecting items required to help restore Colony 9.[XENO:n ]
Lend your services and help collect what's needed.
Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Bright Figs[/System:Color] in Tephra Cave.

Items collected! These should help cheer up the[XENO:n ]
disheartened children.

A Defence Force soldier isn't making much progress[XENO:n ]
collecting items required to help restore Colony 9.[XENO:n ]
Lend your services and help collect what's needed.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Broken Pincers[/System:Color] from Krabbles in[XENO:n ]
Tephra Cave.

Items collected! These should enable the Anti-Air[XENO:n ]
Batteries to be restored.

A Defence Force soldier isn't making much progress[XENO:n ]
collecting an item required to help restore Colony 9.[XENO:n ]
Lend your services and help collect what's needed.

Collect 1 lot of [System:Color name=item ]Brog Smelling Salts[/System:Color] from a Noble[XENO:n ]
Brog in Tephra Cave.

Item collected! This should help treat the injured[XENO:n ]
residents.
